about_the_game:
After waking up in a deep, dark forest, the two follow an unidentified girl into an old hospital. They must avoid enemies in the labyrinth, find a diary, reveal their hidden past, and escape.

Two-player cooperative play - wear different masks with friends and work together with different abilities to avoid enemies.

Rabbits can hear things that are not heard or further away, and owls can see things that are invisible.

Map that changes every time - Complex labyrinths are randomly repositioned with each play!

Finding the way is very difficult, so you can feel like you're wandering in a real mystery.

Various Enemies - there are several monsters in the labyrinth, such as wandering monsters, monsters that suddenly pop out of hiding. Survive by running away from various monsters.

Various Items - There are various items hidden in cabinets, drawers, and bookshelves to survive.

Use items that fit the situation and survive for a long time
